item.description:
When: Friday 06 November 2026, 21:00
Where: Online
Source: Meetup — Thessaloniki tech · Meetup

AI for DevOps & SRE: From Impressive Demos to Operational Trust What would make you trust an AI agent with operational changes? An agent can generate a valid command and still misunderstand the objective. It can mistake missing telemetry for a healthy service, or choose an action outside the scope you authorized. How do we recognize these failures before they affect real systems? Join Bucharest XDevOps Meetup for a practical, vendor-neutral session exploring the risks of AI-assisted operations and the controls that help manage them. We’ll work through three synthetic scenarios in isolated environments: 1. The command is valid, but the objective is wrong. 2. The query returns no data, but the…
